reason: C04 Willem Jacobus has the right names but is marked [died], so it is an estate, and this man was alive to trek after 1829. C05 Willem Wouter is his father, and the other candidates have different given names or parentage.
C11 Stephanus Johannes Schoeman is an exact full-name match in George, his declared district. No other candidate carries both given names.
No candidate is named Adriaan. The owners are Jan Hendrik, Barend Jacobus and a widow, Alida.
Neither Willem Hendrik nor Jacobus Frederik matches Johannes Jurie.
No candidate is Johannes Hermanus Jacobus. C08 Hermanus Jacobus is son of Evert, not of Johannes Hermanus, and C10 Johannes is a widow's entry.
No candidate is named Wessel Hendrik. The only owners are a Hermanus widow entry and Hermanus Johannes.
None of the 33 owners is Johannes Stephanus. The nearest, C20 Nicolaas Johannes Stephanus, has a different first name.
The only candidate, Jacobus Lourens, has entirely different given names from Daniel Balthazar.
Jan Lodewyk shares only the first name (Jan/Johannes), and his second name Lodewyk contradicts Matthys.

Louis is a distinctive given name, and C12 Louis Christiaan Albregt in Swellendam matches it, with the genealogy plausibly omitting the middle names. No other Swellendam owner is a Louis, though the match is weak because no father is recorded to check his 'sv Lourens' note.
